title: A validity-domain atlas for GPU kernels: conditional certificates, not band-global rules
abstract: A kernel speedup is a point sample presented as a property: it does not say which shapes the advantage survives on, which reference realization the pass was scored against, or how much of the benchmark's tolerance budget the reference already spends. We price all three on a DGX Spark (GB10, sm_120). Defining rho as the reference's own consumption in multiples of the contract budget, an ordinary fp32 matmul reference crosses rho = 1 between K = 3608 and 3632 by bisection, and fp32 conv2d is a two-class dispatch surface rather than a depth function: a winograd engine at rho 10.195 with 0.52% of elements over budget and bit-identical output under every precision flag a user is told to set, against TF32 tensor-op engines at rho 251.69 with 78.2% over budget that allow_tf32=False removes 99.9% of. Admission therefore keys on frac_over, not rho_max: a rho_max 10.2 row is conditionally claimable while a rho_max 111 row is bulk-inadmissible. Testing whether the certificate compresses onto derived coordinates, magnitude does (out-of-fold Spearman 0.986 with the engine class supplied) while admission does not (79% bulk accuracy without the class, 100% with it), and the class is only 0.604 predictable against a 0.5625 majority, because dispatch depends on (C, output extent) rather than on the conv parameters. On propagation, an earlier cut was an instrument gap: over six two-stage chains with fp64 anchors, end-to-end consumption is bounded by the worst stage within 1.0-1.5x on five chains, with one deep-reduction chain super-additive at 2.34x, declared. Delivery evidence is retained: gate equals torch on 52/56 conv rows and the paired difference against torch.compile is +11.9/+12.1/+10.3 pp. Four of our own claims were retracted by their pre-registered rules, reported with mechanisms. Every cited number is regenerable by shipped auditors that exit nonzero on a value they cannot reproduce.
change_summary: Round-4 reframe, submitted as a new paper rather than another repair of the selector-first framing (2CmvAb5SC-VGAsbK rejected 10-22 19:51Z, 6yPhozmAt62JSqQs rejected 10-21 19:44Z, O4hnCxiPVenpDr4A rejected earlier). The reviewer arithmetic from all three rounds reproduced and is retained; what changed is the interpretive layer, which is now a certificate rather than a ranking. (1) Reference-realization axis is measured, not assumed: rho is defined in budget multiples and measured on real shapes, with an fp32 matmul crossing located by bisection (K 3608/3632) and fp32 conv resolved into two profiler-named engine classes that differ by 25x at matched reduction depth, one flag-fixable at 99.9% and one flag-invisible. (2) The certificate replaces the dispatcher as the primary contribution: admission keys on frac_over, and the compression test reports that magnitude compresses out of fold (0.986 with the engine class) while admission does not (79% vs 100% bulk accuracy), so the certificate's cost is stated per shape rather than claimed free. (3) Tolerance propagation, previously SCOPE-CUT under a frozen rule, is repaired by measuring composition in the currency the claim needs (budget multiples) on six two-stage chains with fp64 anchors: worst-stage bound within 1.0-1.5x on five, one super-additive chain declared at 2.34x. (4) Four of our own claims are retracted with mechanisms (conv depth law, flag-invisibility attribution, the ineligibility prediction, and the claim that engine class follows from (k,s,d)), the last being that dispatch depends on (C, output extent) with rho moving 20-38x in one step of output extent. (5) Selector economics is demoted to a studied object with its filter inversion repaired (t_b < t_g, v* = P/(t_g - t_b)); the breakeven table reproduces digit-for-digit and conv crossover is exactly zero. (6) Packaging: supplement v5 ships the auditors, the artifacts they read, the round-4 legs, all eight paper sections and the three archived reviews; the packaged auditors were run from inside the package at build time and all exit 0.
